# extract

Extract plugin step/image attributes from an assembly (.dll) or plugin package (.nupkg) to JSON configuration. Works against Dataverse-supported .NET Framework plugin assemblies and net462/net471/net48 plugin package assets regardless of how the CLI is packaged (single-file, self-contained, or framework-dependent).

## Usage

```
ppds plugins extract [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--force` | `-f` | `bool` |  | Overwrite existing file without merging |
| `--input` | `-i` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to assembly (.dll) or plugin package (.nupkg) |
| `--output` | `-o` | `FileInfo` |  | Output file path (default: registrations.json in input directory) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--reference-dir` |  | `DirectoryInfo[]` |  | Additional directory to search for referenced assemblies (repeatable). Use when a plugin's dependencies live outside the input assembly's own folder. |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Solution unique name to add components to |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
